```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(openxlsx)

#==========================================================
# 1. 读取原始数据
#==========================================================
raw <- read_excel(here("DATA", "Rawdata1.xlsx"))
cmp <- read_excel(here("DATA", "Complains_YoungClients.xls"))

#==========================================================
# 2. 清理 ID
#==========================================================
raw <- raw %>%
  mutate(ID_clean = trimws(as.character(ID)))

cmp <- cmp %>%
  mutate(门诊ID_clean = trimws(as.character(门诊ID)))

raw_ids <- raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(ID_clean), ID_clean != "") %>%
  distinct(ID_clean)

cmp_ids <- cmp %>%
  filter(!is.na(门诊ID_clean), 门诊ID_clean != "") %>%
  distinct(门诊ID_clean)

#==========================================================
# 3. Raw 有、Complains 没有的 ID
#==========================================================
raw_id_not_in_cmp <- raw_ids %>%
  anti_join(cmp_ids, by = c("ID_clean" = "门诊ID_clean"))

raw_rows_not_in_cmp <- raw %>%
  semi_join(raw_id_not_in_cmp, by = "ID_clean")

#==========================================================
# 4. Complains 有、Raw 没有的 ID
#==========================================================
cmp_id_not_in_raw <- cmp_ids %>%
  anti_join(raw_ids, by = c("门诊ID_clean" = "ID_clean"))

cmp_rows_not_in_raw <- cmp %>%
  semi_join(cmp_id_not_in_raw, by = "门诊ID_clean")

#==========================================================
# 5. 汇总
#==========================================================
summary_df <- data.frame(
  item = c(
    "Rawdata1 唯一有效 ID 数",
    "Complains 唯一有效 ID 数",
    "Rawdata1 中有、Complains 中没有的唯一 ID 数",
    "Rawdata1 中这些 ID 对应的原始行数",
    "Complains 中有、Rawdata1 中没有的唯一 ID 数",
    "Complains 中这些 ID 对应的原始行数"
  ),
  n = c(
    nrow(raw_ids),
    nrow(cmp_ids),
    nrow(raw_id_not_in_cmp),
    nrow(raw_rows_not_in_cmp),
    nrow(cmp_id_not_in_raw),
    nrow(cmp_rows_not_in_raw)
  )
)

print(summary_df)

#==========================================================
# 6. 导出
#==========================================================
write.xlsx(
  list(
    Summary = summary_df,
    Raw_ID_not_in_Complains = raw_id_not_in_cmp,
    Raw_rows_not_in_Complains = raw_rows_not_in_cmp,
    Complains_ID_not_in_Raw = cmp_id_not_in_raw,
    Complains_rows_not_in_Raw = cmp_rows_not_in_raw
  ),
  here("OUTPUT", "ID_mismatch_check.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("\nID 不匹配核查完成，结果已导出：OUTPUT/ID_mismatch_check.xlsx\n")

```


```{r}
# 预处理是将RAWDATA1和Complains_YoungClients（即未经处理的医生原始数据）进行处理的代码，处理规则如下：
# 在本研究的数据预处理中，Rawdata1.xlsx 与 Complains_YoungClients.xls 两个数据表均包含重复的 ID。
# 为了确保后续分析中每个 ID 仅保留一条最合适的记录，我们制定并实施了如下匹配与筛选规则：
# 1. 两个数据表均出现的 ID（共同 ID）
# 当某个 ID 同时存在于 Rawdata1 与 Complains 数据表中，且各自都可能有多条记录时：
# 规则：找到 Raw 中每条记录与 Complains 中每条记录之间的时间差，保留时间差最小的那一对。
# Raw 表使用字段：提交时间（parsed datetime）
# Complains 表使用字段：就诊日期（parsed datetime）
# 对所有组合计算时间差（绝对值，单位秒）选择时间差最小的一对 仅保留这一行 Raw 及这一行 Complains 其余记录全部删除
# 这样保证共同 ID 在两个文件中都仅保留 最匹配的、最接近的时间点。
# 2. 仅在 Rawdata1 中出现的 ID
# 当某个 ID 出现在 Rawdata1 中，但不出现在 Complains 中时：
# 规则：保留 Rawdata1 中该 ID 的所有记录里 “提交时间最早” 的一条。
# 同时删除该 ID 的其他记录
# 这样保证 Raw 中的独有 ID 也只保留一条最合理的数据。
# 3. 仅在 Complains_YoungClients 中出现的 ID
# 当某个 ID 出现在 Complains 中，但 不出现在 Rawdata1 中时：
# 规则：保留 Complains 中该 ID 的所有记录里 “就诊日期最早” 的一条。
# 同时删除该 ID 的其他记录
# 这保证 Complains 中的独有 ID 也只保留一条最代表性的记录。
# 输出数据文件为：Raw_output.xlsx 也是后续检出率和EGA载入的数据文件。
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
library(openxlsx)
library(stringr)

#==========================================================
# 1. 读取数据
#==========================================================
raw <- read_excel(here("DATA", "Rawdata1.xlsx"))
cmp <- read_excel(here("DATA", "Complains_YoungClients.xls"))

# 强制 ID 字段为字符
raw$ID <- as.character(raw$ID)
cmp$门诊ID <- as.character(cmp$门诊ID)

#==========================================================
# 2. 解析 Raw 的提交时间（英文格式 + 数字格式）
#==========================================================

# 去掉 " CST"
raw$提交时间_clean <- gsub(" CST", "", raw$提交时间, fixed = TRUE)

# 创建解析结果列
raw$提交时间_parsed <- NA

# --- 英文格式 (例: Wed May 25 14:04:35 2022) ---
idx_eng <- grepl("[A-Za-z]{3} [A-Za-z]{3} [0-9]{1,2}", raw$提交时间_clean)

old_locale <- Sys.getlocale("LC_TIME")
Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C")   # 切到英文环境，识别 Wed / May

raw$提交时间_parsed[idx_eng] <- as.POSIXct(
  raw$提交时间_clean[idx_eng],
  format = "%a %b %d %H:%M:%S %Y",
  tz = "Asia/Shanghai"
)

Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", old_locale)  # 解析完恢复

# --- 数字格式 (例: 2023-06-17 10:11:28) ---
idx_num <- grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}", raw$提交时间_clean)

raw$提交时间_parsed[idx_num] <- as.POSIXct(
  raw$提交时间_clean[idx_num],
  format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
  tz = "Asia/Shanghai"
)

#==========================================================
# 3. 解析 Complains 的就诊日期
#==========================================================
cmp$就诊日期_parsed <- as.POSIXct(
  cmp$就诊日期,
  format = "%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S",
  tz = "Asia/Shanghai"
)

#==========================================================
# 4. ID 分类
#==========================================================
common_ids <- intersect(raw$ID, cmp$门诊ID)
only_raw_ids <- setdiff(raw$ID, cmp$门诊ID)
only_cmp_ids <- setdiff(cmp$门诊ID, raw$ID)

#==========================================================
# 5. 共同 ID —— Raw & Complains 时间最接近的一对
#==========================================================
matched_pairs <- raw %>%
  filter(ID %in% common_ids) %>%
  left_join(cmp, by = c("ID" = "门诊ID")) %>%
  mutate(
    time_diff = abs(as.numeric(
      difftime(提交时间_parsed, 就诊日期_parsed, units = "secs")
    )),
    time_diff = ifelse(is.na(time_diff), Inf, time_diff)
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%                          # 每个 ID 只留一行（时间最近）
  slice_min(time_diff, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

#==========================================================
# 6. Raw 独有 ID —— 保留提交时间最早
#==========================================================
raw_only <- raw %>%
  filter(ID %in% only_raw_ids) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  slice_min(提交时间_parsed, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

#==========================================================
# 7. Complains 独有 ID —— 保留最早就诊时间
#==========================================================
cmp_only <- cmp %>%
  filter(门诊ID %in% only_cmp_ids) %>%
  group_by(门诊ID) %>%
  slice_min(就诊日期_parsed, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

#==========================================================
# 8. 组合 Raw 输出数据：每个 Raw ID 一行
#==========================================================
Raw_output <- bind_rows(
  matched_pairs %>% select(any_of(names(raw))),  # 共同 ID 的 Raw 行
  raw_only                                      # Raw 独有 ID
)

#==========================================================
# 9. 组合 Complains 输出数据：每个 门诊ID 一行
#==========================================================
# 先准备一份“来自 matched_pairs 的 Complains 视角”：把 ID 当成 门诊ID 用
cmp_cols <- names(cmp)

cmp_from_matched <- matched_pairs %>%
  mutate(门诊ID = ID) %>%            # 加回 Complains 的键
  select(all_of(cmp_cols))           # 按 Complains 原始列顺序取列

# 再和 Complains 独有的行拼在一起
Cmp_output <- bind_rows(
  cmp_from_matched,
  cmp_only
)

#==========================================================
# 10. 输出 Excel 文件（不会乱码）
#==========================================================
write.xlsx(Raw_output,
           here("OUTPUT", "Raw_output.xlsx"),
           overwrite = TRUE)

write.xlsx(Cmp_output,
           here("OUTPUT", "Complains_output.xlsx"),
           overwrite = TRUE)

cat("全部处理完成！Excel 文件已生成到 OUTPUT 文件夹（两个文件各自每个 ID 只保留一行）。\n")




```





```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1. 清洗病历数据
#    - 现病史非空
#    - 年龄 7-18
#    - 去掉代诊
#    - 标准化诊断字段
# ============================================================
Cmp_step1 <- Cmp_output %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(现病史),
    trimws(as.character(现病史)) != ""
  )

Cmp_step1 <- Cmp_step1 %>%
  mutate(
    出生日期_parsed = as.Date(出生日期, format = "%Y/%m/%d"),
    就诊日期_parsed = as.Date(就诊日期, format = "%Y/%m/%d"),
    Age = as.numeric(difftime(就诊日期_parsed, 出生日期_parsed, units = "days")) / 365.25
  )

Cmp_step2 <- Cmp_step1 %>%
  filter(Age >= 7 & Age <= 18)

Cmp_step3 <- Cmp_step2 %>%
  filter(!grepl("代诊", 主诉))

Cmp_step3 <- Cmp_step3 %>%
  filter(!is.na(诊断), trimws(as.character(诊断)) != "") %>%
  mutate(
    诊断_clean = as.character(诊断),
    诊断_clean = str_replace_all(诊断_clean, "[\r\n\t]", ""),
    诊断_clean = str_squish(诊断_clean),
    诊断_clean = str_replace(诊断_clean, ";+$", "")   # 去掉末尾分号
  )

cat("病历清洗后样本量：", nrow(Cmp_step3), "\n")

# ============================================================
# 2. 定义“纯抑郁”
#    只保留：抑郁状态 / 抑郁障碍
# ============================================================
pure_dep_labels <- c("抑郁状态", "抑郁障碍")

Cmp_depression_pure <- Cmp_step3 %>%
  filter(诊断_clean %in% pure_dep_labels)

Cmp_non_depression <- Cmp_step3 %>%
  filter(!str_detect(诊断_clean, "抑郁"))

cat("纯抑郁样本量：", nrow(Cmp_depression_pure), "\n")
cat("非抑郁样本量：", nrow(Cmp_non_depression), "\n")

# 导出纯抑郁 / 非抑郁病历
write.xlsx(
  Cmp_depression_pure,
  here("OUTPUT", "Complains_output_depression_pure.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

write.xlsx(
  Cmp_non_depression,
  here("OUTPUT", "Complains_output_non_depression.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出：\n")
cat("  - Complains_output_depression_pure.xlsx\n")
cat("  - Complains_output_non_depression.xlsx\n")

# ============================================================
# 3. 给问卷数据打标签（纯抑郁 / 非抑郁）
# ============================================================
Dep_label <- bind_rows(
  Cmp_depression_pure %>%
    transmute(
      ID = as.character(门诊ID),
      Depression_status = "Depression"
    ),
  Cmp_non_depression %>%
    transmute(
      ID = as.character(门诊ID),
      Depression_status = "Non-depression"
    )
) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

Raw_with_label <- Raw_output %>%
  left_join(Dep_label, by = "ID")

Raw_labeled <- Raw_with_label %>%
  filter(!is.na(Depression_status))

Raw_depression <- Raw_labeled %>%
  filter(Depression_status == "Depression")

Raw_non_depression <- Raw_labeled %>%
  filter(Depression_status == "Non-depression")

cat("问卷中纯抑郁样本量：", nrow(Raw_depression), "\n")
cat("问卷中非抑郁样本量：", nrow(Raw_non_depression), "\n")

write.xlsx(
  Raw_labeled,
  here("OUTPUT", "Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label_Pure.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

write.xlsx(
  Raw_depression,
  here("OUTPUT", "Questionnaire_Depression_Pure.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

write.xlsx(
  Raw_non_depression,
  here("OUTPUT", "Questionnaire_Non_Depression.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出：\n")
cat("  - Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label_Pure.xlsx\n")
cat("  - Questionnaire_Depression_Pure.xlsx\n")
cat("  - Questionnaire_Non_Depression.xlsx\n")

# ============================================================
# 4. 构建建模数据（纯抑郁 vs 非抑郁）
#    仅保留病历和问卷都存在的人
#    1:1 平衡抽样
# ============================================================
dep_pool <- Cmp_depression_pure %>%
  mutate(ID = as.character(门诊ID)) %>%
  filter(ID %in% Raw_output$ID)

non_pool <- Cmp_non_depression %>%
  mutate(ID = as.character(门诊ID)) %>%
  filter(ID %in% Raw_output$ID)

n_dep <- nrow(dep_pool)
cat("可用于建模的纯抑郁样本数（病历∩问卷）：", n_dep, "\n")

if (nrow(non_pool) < n_dep) {
  stop("非抑郁池子数量不足，无法做1:1平衡抽样。")
}

dep_sel <- dep_pool %>%
  transmute(
    ID = ID,
    history_text = 现病史,
    label = 1
  )

set.seed(20240211)
non_sel <- non_pool %>%
  slice_sample(n = n_dep) %>%
  transmute(
    ID = ID,
    history_text = 现病史,
    label = 0
  )

y_label <- bind_rows(dep_sel, non_sel) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("平衡后总样本数：", nrow(y_label), "\n")
print(table(y_label$label))

# ============================================================
# 5. 问卷计分
# ============================================================
CDI_reverse_items <- c(
  "CDI2","CDI5","CDI7","CDI8","CDI10","CDI11","CDI13",
  "CDI15","CDI16","CDI18","CDI21","CDI24","CDI25"
)

DSRSC_reverse_items <- c(
  "DSRSC3","DSRSC5","DSRSC6","DSRSC10",
  "DSRSC14","DSRSC15","DSRSC17","DSRSC18"
)

DASS_dep_items <- c(
  "DASS3","DASS5","DASS10",
  "DASS13","DASS16","DASS17","DASS21"
)

qdat <- Raw_output %>%
  filter(ID %in% y_label$ID) %>%
  mutate(across(matches("Gender|Age|DSRSC|PHQ|CDI"), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(across(matches("DSRSC|PHQ|CDI"), ~ .x - 1)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(DASS_dep_items), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(DASS_dep_items), ~ .x - 1)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(intersect(names(.), CDI_reverse_items)), ~ 2 - .x)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(intersect(names(.), DSRSC_reverse_items)), ~ 2 - .x)) %>%
  mutate(
    total_DSRSC = rowSums(select(., starts_with("DSRSC")), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_PHQ   = rowSums(select(., starts_with("PHQ")),   na.rm = TRUE),
    total_DASS  = rowSums(select(., all_of(DASS_dep_items)), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_CDI   = rowSums(select(., starts_with("CDI")),   na.rm = TRUE) -
                  ifelse("CDI26" %in% names(.), CDI26, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(ID, total_DSRSC, total_PHQ, total_CDI, total_DASS)

cat("成功拿到量表总分的样本数：", nrow(qdat), "\n")

# ============================================================
# 6. 合并为机器学习数据
# ============================================================
ml_data <- y_label %>%
  inner_join(qdat, by = "ID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(history_text), trimws(history_text) != "")

cat("最终用于建模的样本数：", nrow(ml_data), "\n")
print(table(ml_data$label))

# ============================================================
# 7. 生成 5-fold
# ============================================================
make_stratified_folds <- function(labels, k = 5, seed = 20240211) {
  set.seed(seed)
  folds <- integer(length(labels))
  for (lab in sort(unique(labels))) {
    idx <- which(labels == lab)
    folds[idx] <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = length(idx)))
  }
  folds
}

ml_data <- ml_data %>%
  mutate(fold = make_stratified_folds(label, k = 5, seed = 20240211)) %>%
  arrange(fold, desc(label))

# ============================================================
# 8. 导出机器学习数据
# ============================================================
write.xlsx(
  ml_data,
  here("OUTPUT", "ML_dataset_balanced_5fold_pure_depression.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出：OUTPUT/ML_dataset_balanced_5fold_pure_depression.xlsx\n")

```


```{r}

library(readr)
library(stringr)
# =========================================================
# 9. 基于纯抑郁版 ML 数据生成 M4 文本
# =========================================================
ml_data_base <- read_excel(
  here("OUTPUT", "ML_dataset_balanced_5fold_pure_depression.xlsx")
) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    history_text = as.character(history_text)
  )

delete_m4 <- read_lines(
  here("OUTPUT", "delete_for_M4_augmented_pure.txt"),
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) %>%
  str_squish() %>%
  unique()

delete_m4 <- delete_m4[delete_m4 != ""]
delete_m4 <- delete_m4[order(nchar(delete_m4), decreasing = TRUE)]

cat("M4 删除表述数量：", length(delete_m4), "\n")

remove_phrases_raw <- function(text, patterns) {
  if (is.na(text) || str_squish(text) == "") {
    return("")
  }

  out <- text
  for (p in patterns) {
    out <- str_replace_all(out, fixed(p), "")
  }
  out
}

clean_text <- function(text) {
  if (is.na(text) || text == "") {
    return("[NO_RELEVANT_TEXT]")
  }

  out <- text
  out <- str_replace_all(out, "[\r\n\t]", "")
  out <- str_replace_all(out, "\\s+", "")
  out <- str_replace_all(out, "[，,]{2,}", "，")
  out <- str_replace_all(out, "[。]{2,}", "。")
  out <- str_replace_all(out, "[；;]{2,}", "；")
  out <- str_replace(out, "^[，,。；;、]+", "")
  out <- str_replace(out, "[，,。；;、]+$", "")
  out <- str_squish(out)

  if (out == "") out <- "[NO_RELEVANT_TEXT]"
  out
}

ml_data_m4 <- ml_data_base %>%
  mutate(
    text_M4_raw = vapply(history_text, remove_phrases_raw, character(1), patterns = delete_m4),
    text_M4 = vapply(text_M4_raw, clean_text, character(1))
  )

changed_idx_m4 <- ml_data_m4$history_text != ml_data_m4$text_M4_raw

cat("M4 真正删到表述的样本数：", sum(changed_idx_m4), "\n")
cat("M4 变成 [NO_RELEVANT_TEXT] 的样本数：", sum(ml_data_m4$text_M4 == "[NO_RELEVANT_TEXT]"), "\n")

write.xlsx(
  ml_data_m4 %>% select(-text_M4_raw),
  here("OUTPUT", "ML_dataset_balanced_5fold_text_M4_pure_depression.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出：OUTPUT/ML_dataset_balanced_5fold_text_M4_pure_depression.xlsx\n")


# =========================================================
# 10. 基于纯抑郁版 ML 数据生成 M3 文本
# =========================================================
delete_m3 <- read_lines(
  here("OUTPUT", "delete_for_M3_augmented_pure.txt"),
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) %>%
  str_squish() %>%
  unique()

delete_m3 <- delete_m3[delete_m3 != ""]
delete_m3 <- delete_m3[order(nchar(delete_m3), decreasing = TRUE)]

cat("M3 删除表述数量：", length(delete_m3), "\n")

ml_data_m3 <- ml_data_base %>%
  mutate(
    text_M3_raw = vapply(history_text, remove_phrases_raw, character(1), patterns = delete_m3),
    text_M3 = vapply(text_M3_raw, clean_text, character(1))
  )

changed_idx_m3 <- ml_data_m3$history_text != ml_data_m3$text_M3_raw

cat("M3 真正删到表述的样本数：", sum(changed_idx_m3), "\n")
cat("M3 变成 [NO_RELEVANT_TEXT] 的样本数：", sum(ml_data_m3$text_M3 == "[NO_RELEVANT_TEXT]"), "\n")

write.xlsx(
  ml_data_m3 %>% select(-text_M3_raw),
  here("OUTPUT", "ML_dataset_balanced_5fold_text_M3_pure_depression.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出：OUTPUT/ML_dataset_balanced_5fold_text_M3_pure_depression.xlsx\n")
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)
library(purrr)

# =========================================================
# 0. 读取纯抑郁版机器学习总数据
# =========================================================
ml_data <- read_excel(
  here("OUTPUT", "ML_dataset_balanced_5fold_pure_depression.xlsx")
) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    history_text = as.character(history_text),
    label = as.integer(label)
  )

cat("总样本数：", nrow(ml_data), "\n")
cat("抑郁组样本数：", sum(ml_data$label == 1), "\n")
cat("非抑郁组样本数：", sum(ml_data$label == 0), "\n")

# =========================================================
# 1. 读取删词表（纯抑郁版）
#    注意：仍然按长度从长到短排序
# =========================================================
delete_m3 <- read_lines(
  here("OUTPUT", "delete_for_M3_pure.txt"),
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) %>%
  str_squish() %>%
  unique()

delete_m3 <- delete_m3[delete_m3 != ""]
delete_m3 <- delete_m3[order(nchar(delete_m3), decreasing = TRUE)]

delete_m4 <- read_lines(
  here("OUTPUT", "delete_for_M4_augmented_pure.txt"),
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) %>%
  str_squish() %>%
  unique()

delete_m4 <- delete_m4[delete_m4 != ""]
delete_m4 <- delete_m4[order(nchar(delete_m4), decreasing = TRUE)]

cat("M3 表述数量：", length(delete_m3), "\n")
cat("M4 表述数量：", length(delete_m4), "\n")

# =========================================================
# 2. 核心函数：长表述优先，命中后遮罩，避免短表述重复命中
# =========================================================

# 用同长度遮罩字符替换，避免删掉后前后文本拼接造成误匹配
mask_phrase_fixed <- function(text, phrase, mask_char = "□") {
  if (is.na(text) || text == "") return(text)
  mask_str <- str_dup(mask_char, str_length(phrase))
  str_replace_all(text, fixed(phrase), mask_str)
}

# 对一条文本做“非重叠命中检测”
# 返回：
# 1) hit_any：是否至少命中一个表述
# 2) n_hit：命中了多少个“不同表述条目”（非重叠）
# 3) hit_phrases：真正命中的表述列表（长表述优先，短表述不重复吃到）
# 4) masked_text：遮罩后的文本（便于debug）
detect_patterns_nonoverlap <- function(text, patterns) {
  if (is.na(text) || trimws(text) == "") {
    return(list(
      hit_any = FALSE,
      n_hit = 0L,
      hit_phrases = character(0),
      masked_text = text
    ))
  }

  working_text <- text
  hit_phrases <- character(0)

  for (p in patterns) {
    if (str_detect(working_text, fixed(p))) {
      hit_phrases <- c(hit_phrases, p)
      working_text <- mask_phrase_fixed(working_text, p)
    }
  }

  list(
    hit_any = length(hit_phrases) > 0,
    n_hit = length(hit_phrases),
    hit_phrases = hit_phrases,
    masked_text = working_text
  )
}

# 批量对一列文本跑非重叠命中
batch_detect_nonoverlap <- function(text_vec, patterns) {
  res <- lapply(text_vec, detect_patterns_nonoverlap, patterns = patterns)

  tibble(
    hit_any = vapply(res, function(x) x$hit_any, logical(1)),
    n_hit = vapply(res, function(x) x$n_hit, integer(1)),
    hit_phrases = vapply(res, function(x) paste(x$hit_phrases, collapse = " | "), character(1)),
    masked_text = vapply(res, function(x) {
      if (is.null(x$masked_text) || is.na(x$masked_text)) "" else x$masked_text
    }, character(1))
  )
}

# =========================================================
# 3. 每个样本：是否命中、命中多少（非重叠版）
# =========================================================
m3_detect <- batch_detect_nonoverlap(ml_data$history_text, delete_m3)
m4_detect <- batch_detect_nonoverlap(ml_data$history_text, delete_m4)

ml_hit <- ml_data %>%
  mutate(
    hit_any_M3 = m3_detect$hit_any,
    hit_any_M4 = m4_detect$hit_any,
    n_hit_M3 = m3_detect$n_hit,
    n_hit_M4 = m4_detect$n_hit,
    hit_phrases_M3 = m3_detect$hit_phrases,
    hit_phrases_M4 = m4_detect$hit_phrases
  )

write.xlsx(
  ml_hit,
  here("OUTPUT", "ML_dataset_phrase_hits_nonoverlap_pure.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出样本级命中结果：ML_dataset_phrase_hits_nonoverlap_pure.xlsx\n")

# =========================================================
# 4. 整体命中率比较（非重叠版）
# =========================================================
overall_summary <- ml_hit %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    prop_hit_any_M3 = mean(hit_any_M3),
    prop_hit_any_M4 = mean(hit_any_M4),
    mean_n_hit_M3 = mean(n_hit_M3),
    mean_n_hit_M4 = mean(n_hit_M4),
    median_n_hit_M3 = median(n_hit_M3),
    median_n_hit_M4 = median(n_hit_M4),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(group = ifelse(label == 1, "Depression", "Non-depression")) %>%
  select(group, everything(), -label)

print(overall_summary)

write.xlsx(
  overall_summary,
  here("OUTPUT", "Phrase_hit_overall_summary_nonoverlap_pure.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出整体命中率表：Phrase_hit_overall_summary_nonoverlap_pure.xlsx\n")

# =========================================================
# 5. 单表述组间比较（非重叠归属版）
#    逻辑：
#    - 每条文本先按“长表述优先”做唯一归属
#    - 然后统计每个 phrase 在多少个样本中被归属命中
# =========================================================
phrase_summary_nonoverlap <- function(data, patterns, prefix_name) {
  # 先对所有样本做一次非重叠检测
  det_list <- lapply(data$history_text, detect_patterns_nonoverlap, patterns = patterns)

  # 展开成 样本 x phrase 的归属表
  hit_rows <- lapply(seq_along(det_list), function(i) {
    hp <- det_list[[i]]$hit_phrases
    if (length(hp) == 0) return(NULL)

    data.frame(
      ID = data$ID[i],
      label = data$label[i],
      phrase = hp,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  hit_df <- bind_rows(hit_rows)

  n_dep <- sum(data$label == 1)
  n_non <- sum(data$label == 0)

  if (nrow(hit_df) == 0) {
    out <- data.frame(
      phrase = patterns,
      dep_hits = 0,
      non_hits = 0,
      dep_prop = 0,
      non_prop = 0,
      diff_prop = 0,
      ratio_prop = NA_real_
    )
  } else {
    out <- hit_df %>%
      group_by(phrase, label) %>%
      summarise(n = n_distinct(ID), .groups = "drop") %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = label,
        values_from = n,
        values_fill = 0
      )

    # 防止某一列不存在
    if (!"0" %in% names(out)) out[["0"]] <- 0
    if (!"1" %in% names(out)) out[["1"]] <- 0

    out <- out %>%
      transmute(
        phrase = phrase,
        dep_hits = `1`,
        non_hits = `0`,
        dep_prop = dep_hits / n_dep,
        non_prop = non_hits / n_non,
        diff_prop = dep_prop - non_prop,
        ratio_prop = ifelse(non_prop == 0, NA, dep_prop / non_prop)
      ) %>%
      right_join(
        data.frame(phrase = patterns, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
        by = "phrase"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        dep_hits = coalesce(dep_hits, 0),
        non_hits = coalesce(non_hits, 0),
        dep_prop = coalesce(dep_prop, 0),
        non_prop = coalesce(non_prop, 0),
        diff_prop = coalesce(diff_prop, 0),
        ratio_prop = ifelse(non_prop == 0, NA, dep_prop / non_prop)
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(diff_prop), desc(dep_hits))
  }

  write.xlsx(
    out,
    here("OUTPUT", paste0("Phrase_group_comparison_nonoverlap_", prefix_name, "_pure.xlsx")),
    overwrite = TRUE
  )

  cat("已导出：", paste0("Phrase_group_comparison_nonoverlap_", prefix_name, "_pure.xlsx"), "\n")
  out
}

m3_phrase_summary <- phrase_summary_nonoverlap(ml_hit, delete_m3, "M3")
m4_phrase_summary <- phrase_summary_nonoverlap(ml_hit, delete_m4, "M4")

print(head(m3_phrase_summary, 20))
print(head(m4_phrase_summary, 20))

# =========================================================
# 6. 对 M3 / M4 单表述做 Fisher 精确检验 + BH校正
# =========================================================

add_fisher_stats <- function(df, n_dep, n_non) {
  df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      fisher_res = list(
        fisher.test(
          matrix(
            c(
              dep_hits,
              n_dep - dep_hits,
              non_hits,
              n_non - non_hits
            ),
            nrow = 2,
            byrow = TRUE
          )
        )
      ),
      p_value = fisher_res$p.value,
      odds_ratio = unname(fisher_res$estimate),
      conf_low = fisher_res$conf.int[1],
      conf_high = fisher_res$conf.int[2]
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    select(
      phrase,
      dep_hits, non_hits,
      dep_prop, non_prop, diff_prop, ratio_prop,
      odds_ratio, conf_low, conf_high,
      p_value, p_adj_bh
    ) %>%
    arrange(p_adj_bh, desc(diff_prop), desc(dep_hits))
}

# 当前数据里的两组总人数
n_dep <- sum(ml_hit$label == 1)
n_non <- sum(ml_hit$label == 0)

# M3
m3_phrase_summary_fisher <- add_fisher_stats(
  m3_phrase_summary,
  n_dep = n_dep,
  n_non = n_non
)

write.xlsx(
  m3_phrase_summary_fisher,
  here("OUTPUT", "Phrase_group_comparison_nonoverlap_M3_pure_with_fisher.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出：Phrase_group_comparison_nonoverlap_M3_pure_with_fisher.xlsx\n")

# M4
m4_phrase_summary_fisher <- add_fisher_stats(
  m4_phrase_summary,
  n_dep = n_dep,
  n_non = n_non
)

write.xlsx(
  m4_phrase_summary_fisher,
  here("OUTPUT", "Phrase_group_comparison_nonoverlap_M4_pure_with_fisher.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出：Phrase_group_comparison_nonoverlap_M4_pure_with_fisher.xlsx\n")

# =========================================================
# 7. 打印校正后显著的表述
# =========================================================
cat("\n===== M3：BH校正后显著的表述（p_adj_bh < 0.05）=====\n")
print(
  m3_phrase_summary_fisher %>%
    filter(p_adj_bh < 0.05),
  n = 100
)

cat("\n===== M4：BH校正后显著的表述（p_adj_bh < 0.05）=====\n")
print(
  m4_phrase_summary_fisher %>%
    filter(p_adj_bh < 0.05),
  n = 100
)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================

#     M5 = 删除所有人工整理出的症状表述
# =========================================================

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)

ml_data_base <- read_excel(
  here("OUTPUT", "ML_dataset_balanced_5fold_pure_depression.xlsx")
) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    history_text = as.character(history_text)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 读取 M5 总删词表
# 建议提前准备：delete_for_M5_pure.txt
# ---------------------------------------------------------
delete_m5 <- read_lines(
  here("OUTPUT", "delete_for_M5_augmented_pure.txt"),
  locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")
) %>%
  str_squish() %>%
  unique()

delete_m5 <- delete_m5[delete_m5 != ""]
delete_m5 <- delete_m5[order(nchar(delete_m5), decreasing = TRUE)]

cat("M5 删除表述数量：", length(delete_m5), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 删除函数：从原始 history_text 开始删除
# ---------------------------------------------------------
remove_phrases_raw <- function(text, patterns) {
  if (is.na(text) || str_squish(text) == "") {
    return("")
  }

  out <- text
  for (p in patterns) {
    out <- str_replace_all(out, fixed(p), "")
  }
  out
}

clean_text <- function(text) {
  if (is.na(text) || text == "") {
    return("[NO_RELEVANT_TEXT]")
  }

  out <- text
  out <- str_replace_all(out, "[\r\n\t]", "")
  out <- str_replace_all(out, "\\s+", "")
  out <- str_replace_all(out, "[，,]{2,}", "，")
  out <- str_replace_all(out, "[。]{2,}", "。")
  out <- str_replace_all(out, "[；;]{2,}", "；")
  out <- str_replace(out, "^[，,。；;、]+", "")
  out <- str_replace(out, "[，,。；;、]+$", "")
  out <- str_squish(out)

  if (out == "") out <- "[NO_RELEVANT_TEXT]"
  out
}

ml_data_m5 <- ml_data_base %>%
  mutate(
    text_M5_raw = vapply(history_text, remove_phrases_raw, character(1), patterns = delete_m5),
    text_M5 = vapply(text_M5_raw, clean_text, character(1))
  )

changed_idx_m5 <- ml_data_m5$history_text != ml_data_m5$text_M5_raw

cat("M5 真正删到表述的样本数：", sum(changed_idx_m5), "\n")
cat("M5 变成 [NO_RELEVANT_TEXT] 的样本数：", sum(ml_data_m5$text_M5 == "[NO_RELEVANT_TEXT]"), "\n")

write.xlsx(
  ml_data_m5 %>% select(-text_M5_raw),
  here("OUTPUT", "ML_dataset_balanced_5fold_text_M5_pure_depression.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("已导出：OUTPUT/ML_dataset_balanced_5fold_text_M5_pure_depression.xlsx\n")
```

```{r}
phrase_summary_nonoverlap <- function(data, patterns) {

        ratio_prop = ifelse(non_prop == 0, NA, dep_prop / non_prop)
      ) %>%

        data.frame(phrase = patterns, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),

        non_prop = coalesce(non_prop, 0),

        ratio_prop = ifelse(non_prop == 0, NA, dep_prop / non_prop)
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(diff_prop), desc(dep_hits))
  }

  out
}
```
